# Faisal's journal (p04) — BodyTracker

## Day 1 (Sun 2026-10-04)
- Setup was easy. Put 185 cm, 19, 61.7 kg, male, "Lightly active" (I'm a student, walk around campus, gym sometimes). Said "Yes" I've eaten like this for weeks — I always eat a lot.
- Profile weight became today's weigh-in automatically. Nice, didn't have to add it twice.
- Nutrition tab said "maintain" at first. Had to find the ⚙ to set Gain. It told me "Your BMI is below 18.5, so weight-loss targets are turned off" — ok, kind of a slap in the face but true. Set Gain at 0.5%/wk (the max it suggests, I want to bulk FAST).
- Maintenance 2,310 ± 540, target 2,520. I logged 2,855 today (oats 735, fish & rice 1034, nuts 351, steak 735). So the app thinks I'm already ABOVE my gain target?? That's exactly my problem: I eat a lot and don't gain.
- Confusion: "Add entry" appears twice (a heading and the button).
- Confusion: after adding the nuts without macros, the day total stopped showing protein/carbs/fat, and the Protein card on Nutrition shows "— g / 99 g" even though I logged 83 g protein in the other meals. I expected it to count the protein I did enter. (screens/1790457187876.png)
- Marked day complete.

## Day 2 (Mon)
- Went to add my weight and tapped the big "Weight" card — it opened a "Weight trend" chart instead of an add screen. The add button is the small "+ Weight" at the bottom. Took me a second. (screens/1790457201979.png)
- Weight 61.6. Logged 3,029 kcal today (labneh sandwich had no macros on the label so I only put kcal).
- Nutrition still says "An on-track check needs 14 days of data (day 1 so far)" — but it's day 2 and I logged 2 full days. I guess it only updates on Sundays? Confusing.
- Avg intake shows 2,942 — way above the 2,520 target. And I'm not gaining. Protein still "—".

## Day 3 (Tue)
- 61.8 kg. Logged 3,712 kcal — big day (kabsa 1424, cookies, steak). All with macros.
- Now the Protein card works: "154 g / 99 g · average of 1 complete day(s) with protein logged". So the days where one item had no macros (Day 1 nuts, Day 2 labneh) don't count for protein at all. Would be nicer if it counted what I did enter.
- Opened "Explain the math". Honestly lost me: Hall 2008, Forbes, MAD, φ... I'm a student not a scientist. I got one thing: the target is maintenance 2,314 + 204 for gaining 0.5%/wk = 2,518. Also text has weird spacing like "3 day s", "3 daily weight s". (screens/1790457279946.png)
- Avg intake 3,199 vs target 2,520. According to the app I should be gaining like crazy.

## Day 4 (Wed)
- 62.2 kg! Up 0.5. Trend 61.8. Finally something. Logged 3,089.
- New stuff on Nutrition: carbs ~405 g / fat ≥56 g targets, and "Maintenance is still mostly the formula estimate (0% from your data). It becomes Measured once ... typically 3–5 weeks". OK so the app itself doesn't know me yet. Fair.
- "Last 14 days" lists 09-24..10-03 as "not logged" even though I only installed on 10-04. Looks like I skipped days.

## Day 5 (Thu)
- 62.3 kg. Logged 3,180. Routine is smooth now: Nutrition → + Food → type → Add entry → ✕. 4 meals = 4 times opening the popup. Would love a "copy yesterday" or favourites since I eat oats/kabsa/steak/pasta on repeat.
- Tomorrow is Friday, I don't weigh on weekends.

## Day 6 (Fri)
- No weigh-in (weekend). Logged 3,130, marked complete. Nothing new on screen.

## Day 7 (Sat)
- No weigh-in. Logged 3,713 (pizza night). 7/7 days complete.

## Week 1 (checked Day 7, Sat 2026-10-10)
- App says: maintenance 2,310 ± 540 kcal/day, "Estimated, 0% from your data". Target 2,520 (gain 0.5%/wk). Recommendation: "Suggested intake 2,520 kcal/day. An on-track check needs 14 days of data (day 1 so far)". No warnings. Body comp: "Not enough data yet". Protein 122 g vs 99 g target. Avg intake 3,244.
- What I understand: the app thinks I burn ~2,300 and should eat ~2,500 to gain. But I'm eating 3,200+ and weight went 61.7 → 62.3 (last weigh-in), trend only 61.8. The app hasn't noticed the mismatch yet — it still says "day 1 so far" which is from last Sunday's update.
- What I do: nothing changes. I eat what I eat (and honestly the app telling me 2,520 sounds like LESS food, which makes no sense for a guy who can't gain). Waiting for tomorrow's Sunday update.

## Day 8 (Sun) — first weekly update
- 62.1 kg. Logged 3,125 (chicken salad no macros).
- Sunday update: maintenance now 2,440 ± 490, target 2,640, "Estimated · 19% from your data". Weight change "+1.18 kg/week (95%: 0.40 to 1.97)". Wait, what? It says I'm gaining over a kilo a week? The scale went 61.7 → 62.1. That doesn't feel like 1.18/week to me, but OK it's early.
- From here on I use a little script to type my meals into the app (same taps as by hand) — notes in runlog.txt.

## Week 2 (checked Day 14, Sat 2026-10-17)
- Weights this week: 62.1, 62.4, 62.5, 62.8, 62.0 (Thu dip), none Fri/Sat. Avg intake 3,369, all 14 days complete.
- App (from last Sunday's update): maintenance 2,440 ± 490, target 2,640, Estimated 19% from data, +1.18 kg/week (0.40 to 1.97). Recommendation just "Suggested intake 2,640". Still "on-track check needs 14 days (day 8 so far)". No warnings.
- Body composition breakdown: "Not enough data yet" — needs 3 body-fat readings at each end. I don't have a body-fat scale, so this will never fill for me. Kind of an empty half of the app.
- What I think: the scale IS finally going up a bit (62.8 max!). But the app says my target is 2,640 and I'm eating ~3,370. If I believed it I'd eat 700 less and lose it all. Not touching my food — sticking to my usual for the first month like I planned.

## Week 3 (Sunday update Day 15; checked Day 21, Sat 2026-10-24)
- Weights: 62.8, 62.8, 62.0, 61.6, 62.3 (none Fri/Sat). Up and down like crazy. Avg intake this week 2,831 (my portions were smaller some days, just how life went).
- App: maintenance 2,650 ± 400 (was 2,440), target 2,850, Estimated 46% from data. Rate +0.84 kg/week (95% 0.22 to 1.47). Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (+0.22 to +1.47 kg/week) includes your target of +0.31 kg/week. Suggested intake: 2,850 kcal/day."
- New warning mid-week: "Protein averaged 79 g on 2 logged day(s) vs a 100 g target." Then 89 g on 4 days after I fixed some entries.
- My understanding: the app keeps raising my maintenance every week (2,310 → 2,440 → 2,650). So it IS figuring out that I burn more than the formula said — that's the "fast metabolism" I always tell people about! And it says I'm "on track". But it also says I'm gaining 0.84 kg/week, and the scale doesn't look like that to me — I was 61.7 and I'm 62.3. That's 0.6 in 3 weeks, not 0.84 a week. Confusing.
- Mistake on my side: on Days 17/19/20 some foods had only protein on the label (no carbs/fat) and I typed only calories. Went back tonight and used "Edit" to add the protein. Edit worked fine: tap Edit → the form at the bottom turns into "Edit entry" with Save changes/Cancel. Took a scroll to find Save changes though, the form is below the list.
- Nice: day total shows "· 105 g protein" once every entry has protein, even without carbs/fat.
- Decision: still week 3 of my "eat like normal" month. No change.

## Week 4 (Sunday update Day 22; checked Day 28, Sat 2026-10-31)
- Weights: 61.2, 61.5, 61.1, 62.1, 61.9. Trend weight 61.9 kg. After 4 weeks of eating 3,000+ (by my count) I'm +0.2 kg. Classic me.
- App: maintenance 2,920 ± 320 (up again!), target 3,130, label switched to **Measured** (65% from your data). Rate −0.17 kg/week (95% −0.75 to +0.41). Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.75 to +0.41 kg per week) includes your target of +0.31 kg/week. Suggested intake 3,130 kcal/day." Protein 112 g / 99 g — fine now. The "still mostly formula" note disappeared.
- Confusion: it says "On track" but the rate right next to it is MINUS 0.17 kg/week. I want to gain. How is losing weight "on track" for a gain goal? I think it means "we can't rule it out", but "On track" reads like "you're doing great". It's not. (screens/1790457986340.png)
- What I understand: my body burns ~2,900, not 2,300 like it first said. So the "3,000+" I eat is basically maintenance. That's why I don't gain. Makes sense honestly.
- Decision: 4-week test done. From now on I do exactly what the app says: plan 3,130 kcal/day.

## Day 29 (Sun 2026-11-01) — week 5 update, first day following the app
- 61.4 kg. Logged 3,801 today (plan started tomorrow).
- New recommendation: "Your estimated rate (−1.22 to −0.03 kg per week) doesn't include your target of +0.31 kg/week. Eating about 620 kcal/day more than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 3,010 kcal/day." Maintenance went DOWN to 2,810 ± 350 (Measured 60%). Avg intake card says 3,445.
- **Big confusion / possible bug:** it tells me to eat 620 MORE than recently, but the suggested number (3,010) is LOWER than what I've been logging (avg card 3,445; Explain page says 3,214 mean over 28 complete days). Last week it suggested 3,130; now that I'm losing, it suggests LESS food? For someone trying to gain that's backwards. (screens/1790458047088.png, 1790458048989.png)
- Explain the math, section 8 "Cross-check (regression)": 3,214 kcal mean − (−0.0242 × 4,623) = **3,330 ± 200** maintenance. "Differs from the filter by 519 kcal (limit 398)... the filter's estimate is used." So even the app's own second method says my maintenance is ~3,330, but it shows 2,810 and bases the target on that. And the "Limits" note says if you under/over-log, recommendations "still work because they're relative to your own logging" — but here they aren't: the target is below my own logged average.
- Decision: I said I'd follow the app exactly, so I follow the Suggested intake number: plan 3,010. (Had set 3,130 last night from the old suggestion.)

## Week 5 (checked Day 35, Sat 2026-11-07)
- Eating ~3,010 by plan (my logged totals still bounce 2,088–4,116, I estimate generously and some days are just bigger). Weights: 61.1, 60.7, 61.3, 61.2. Still going nowhere, slightly down from 61.7 start.
- App (unchanged since Sunday): maintenance 2,810 ± 350, target 3,010, Measured 60%, rate −0.63 kg/wk (−1.22 to −0.03). "Eat about 620 kcal/day more than recently... Suggested 3,010." Avg intake card 3,399.
- Day 31: banner "It's been 30+ days since your last backup" (Back up now | Later). Tapped Back up now → "Your data" screen. Full backup (JSON) downloaded fine, "Last backup" updated. Screen says "Persistent storage: not granted by the browser" — no idea what I'm supposed to do about that.
- Feeling: I'm doing what it says and still losing. The "620 more" line vs the 3,010 number still bugs me. Waiting for tomorrow's update.

## Day 36 (Sun 2026-11-08) — week 6 update
- 61.3 kg. App: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.72 to +0.69 kg/week) includes your target +0.31. Suggested 3,030." Maintenance 2,830 ± 360, Measured 57% (went DOWN from 60%?). Rate −0.02 kg/wk.
- "On track" again while I'm flat at −0.02. The range is so wide (−0.72 to +0.69) that basically anything counts as "on track". Plan → 3,030.

## Week 6 (checked Day 42, Sat 2026-11-14)
- Weights: 61.6, 62.3, 62.0, 61.5. Logged 3,055–4,179 (my "about 3,030" days still come out 3,400+ when I add up labels — I round up).
- App: maintenance 2,830 ± 360, target 3,030, Measured 57%, "On track", rate −0.02 kg/wk. Avg intake card 3,498 — that's 470 ABOVE the target, and the app doesn't say a word about it. If I'm eating 3,500 and flat, how is 3,030 going to make me gain?
- Keeping plan 3,030 because that's the deal.

## Day 43 (Sun 2026-11-15) — week 7 update
- 61.2 kg (hm, lower). App: maintenance 3,000 ± 310, target 3,200, Measured 69%, rate +0.30 kg/wk (−0.17 to +0.76), "On track. Suggested 3,200." Plan → 3,200.
- Carbs/fat cards now show "— g" today — some of my entries have no macros, so it gave up on them.
- Rate says +0.30/week but the scale today is 61.2, lower than my start. The rate and the scale don't feel connected.

## Week 7 (checked Day 49, Sat 2026-11-21)
- Weights: 61.4, 61.2, 61.6, 61.2. SEVEN weeks in, I'm lighter than day 1 (61.7).
- App: maintenance 3,000 ± 310, target 3,200, Measured 69%, "On track", +0.30 kg/wk. Avg intake card 3,045. Protein 94 g vs 98 g — just under.
- The app keeps saying "On track" with a +0.30 kg/week rate, and my scale has literally not moved in 7 weeks. I trust my scale more. Starting to feel like "On track" is just the default message.
- Following 3,200 anyway.

## Day 50 (Sun 2026-11-22) — week 8 update
- 61.7 kg (exactly where I started 7 weeks ago). App: maintenance 3,010 ± 310, target 3,220, Measured 68%, rate +0.21 (−0.29 to +0.71), "On track. Suggested 3,220." Plan → 3,220 (+20 kcal, lol, that's a date).

## Week 8 (checked Day 56, Sat 2026-11-28)
- Weights: 60.9, 61.0, 62.0, 62.3. Trend 61.5. Logged a lot this week (3,082–4,145; avg card 3,697).
- App: maintenance 3,010 ± 310, target 3,220, Measured 68%, "On track", +0.21 kg/wk. Protein fine (133 g).
- Opened the weight trend chart (3M): honestly the best screen in the app. You can SEE it: went up to ~62.3 in mid-October, dropped to ~61.4 in November, flat since. That picture tells me more than all the "On track" messages. (screens/1790458705474.png)
- My logged average (3,697 this week) is way over the 3,220 target and the app says nothing about it. I'm "following" 3,220 but my label math always comes out higher.

## Day 57 (Sun 2026-11-29) — week 9 update
- 62.4 kg! App: maintenance 3,020 ± 310, target 3,220 (same), Measured 68%, +0.28 kg/wk (−0.22 to +0.77), "On track. Suggested 3,220." Plan stays 3,220.

## Week 9 (checked Day 63, Sat 2026-12-05)
- Weights: 61.8, 62.0, 62.1, 62.4. Going up a little! Logged avg 3,661 (one 4,919 day — wedding food).
- App: maintenance 3,020 ± 310, target 3,220, Measured 68%, "On track", +0.28 kg/wk. No warnings. Nothing new appeared.
- Still on plan 3,220.

## Day 64 (Sun 2026-12-06) — week 10 update
- 62.5 kg. App: maintenance 3,040 ± 310, target 3,240, Measured 67%, +0.51 kg/wk (−0.04 to +1.06). "On track. Suggested 3,240." Plan → 3,240.

## Week 10 (checked Day 70, Sat 2026-12-12)
- Weights: 62.6, 62.6, 62.3, 62.2. Best week so far — hovering ~62.4.
- App: maintenance 3,040 ± 310, target 3,240, Measured 67%, "On track", +0.51 kg/wk (−0.04 to +1.06). Avg intake card ~3,586.
- New: "2026-12-07: macros add up to ~3484 kcal vs 4221 kcal logged (17% apart). One of the numbers may be off." Yeah... the kabsa I put at 1,794 kcal. I round up, I know. It stayed on screen all week though, for one day's typo-ish thing. Didn't fix it — that's what I estimated.
- Backup banner came back exactly 30 days after my last backup. Did another Full backup. Banner gone.
- Plan stays 3,240.

## Day 71 (Sun 2026-12-13) — week 11 update
- 62.1 kg. App: maintenance 3,190 ± 300 (up 150!), target 3,390, Measured 69%, +0.21 (−0.27 to +0.69), "On track. Suggested 3,390". Plan → 3,390. The 12-07 macro warning is still showing a week later.

## Week 11 (checked Day 77, Sat 2026-12-19)
- Weights: 62.9 (!!), 62.4, 62.7, 62.6. Actually moving now. Logged avg card 4,099 — my food diary says I eat 4,000 a day, lol.
- App: maintenance 3,190 ± 300, target 3,390, Measured 69%, "On track", +0.21 kg/wk. New macro warning for 12-14 (macros ~5,367 vs 4,518 logged, 19% apart) — label numbers, I typed what the packages/apps said.
- My logged intake is 700 kcal/day ABOVE target and the app never tells me "you're eating over your target". For a gain goal I guess that's fine, but it's weird that it's silent.
- Plan stays 3,390.

## Day 78 (Sun 2026-12-20) — week 12 update
- 63.4 kg!!! New record. App: maintenance 3,180 ± 310, target 3,390, Measured 68%, +0.67 kg/wk (+0.14 to +1.19), "On track. Suggested 3,390." Plan stays 3,390.

## Week 12 (checked Day 84, Sat 2026-12-26)
- Weights: 63.5, 63.0, 62.8, 63.5. Trend 62.8 kg, "▲ 1.8 kg" vs first on the Body tab. Up from 61.7!
- App: maintenance 3,180 ± 310, target 3,390, Measured 68%, "On track", +0.67 kg/wk (+0.14 to +1.19). Macro warning for 12-22 (21% apart). Protein 117/100.
- Following 3,390.

## End: backup + export
- "Your data" screen: 60 weigh-ins, 0 measurement entries, 336 food entries, 84 complete days. Last backup was 2026-12-12.
- Full backup (JSON) → downloads/bodytracker-backup-2026-12-26.json. Opened it: has entries (60), food (336), days (84), settings, goals. Looks complete. It's raw JSON, not something I can read on a phone, but fine for restoring.
- Daily export "All data" → downloads/bodytracker-daily_2026-10-04_to_2026-12-26.json. One block per day with weight + calories + macros. Days where one meal had no macros show only calories (Oct 4/5) or only protein (Dec 25). It doesn't include what the app thought my maintenance/target was each week — that's what I'd actually want to look back at.
- Small thing: daily export time is "+03:00" local, backup time is UTC "Z".

## Final review
Honestly, the app answered the question I've had for years: why I "eat so much" and don't gain. It started me at ~2,300 maintenance and, week after week, pushed it up to ~3,200 — so the 3,000+ I was eating was just maintenance for me. Once I followed its targets I finally went from 61.7 to ~63.5 (trend 62.8). The weight chart is great.
What annoyed me: "On track" shows up almost every week, even when the rate next to it was −0.17 or −0.02 kg/week — that's not on track for a bulk, it just means "we're not sure". And the week-5 advice was flat out confusing: "eat 620 kcal/day more than recently" but the suggested number (3,010) was LOWER than what I'd been logging (3,200–3,400). If I hadn't been stubborn I'd have eaten less while trying to gain. Also the app never mentions that my logged intake is 400–700 above the target every week — it just quietly works around my numbers. The Explain page is for scientists. Body composition half of the app was empty the whole time because I don't own a body-fat scale. Logging 4 meals a day by hand with no favourites/copy-yesterday is tedious.
Would I keep using it? Maybe — probably yes for the weight trend and the weekly number, but I'd stop trusting "On track".

# p04 — Faisal (19, M, 185 cm, 61.7 kg, bulking) — final reply

## 1. Usage
- I used the app on all 84 of 84 days (2026-10-04 → 2026-12-26).
- I logged 336 meals (4 a day), marked 84 of 84 days complete and did 60 weigh-ins (none on Fri/Sat).
- Weight went from 61.7 to 63.5 (last reading). Trend weight 62.8 kg, "▲ 1.8 kg" vs first.
- Days 1–7 by hand. From day 8 a script in my folder (runday.mjs) did the same taps and typing. I reviewed the screens after each batch of 7 days or fewer.

## 2. Weekly table (values after each Sunday update; checked every 7th day)
| wk | maintenance shown | target | label | recommendation | what I did |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 2,310 ± 540 | 2,520 | Estimated 0% | Suggested 2,520; on-track check needs 14 days | ate usual (~3,240 logged) |
| 2 | 2,440 ± 490 | 2,640 | Estimated 19% | Suggested 2,640; still "needs 14 days" | ate usual |
| 3 | 2,650 ± 400 | 2,850 | Estimated 46% | On track (+0.84 kg/wk) | ate usual |
| 4 | 2,920 ± 320 | 3,130 | Measured 65% | "On track" though rate −0.17 kg/wk | end of 4-wk test → plan 3,130 |
| 5 | 2,810 ± 350 | 3,010 | Measured 60% | Off track: "eat ~620 kcal/day more than recently", Suggested 3,010 | plan 3,010 (followed the number) |
| 6 | 2,830 ± 360 | 3,030 | Measured 57% | On track (−0.02 kg/wk) | plan 3,030 |
| 7 | 3,000 ± 310 | 3,200 | Measured 69% | On track (+0.30) | plan 3,200 |
| 8 | 3,010 ± 310 | 3,220 | Measured 68% | On track (+0.21) | plan 3,220 |
| 9 | 3,020 ± 310 | 3,220 | Measured 68% | On track (+0.28) | kept 3,220 |
| 10 | 3,040 ± 310 | 3,240 | Measured 67% | On track (+0.51); macro-mismatch note | plan 3,240; did backup from banner |
| 11 | 3,190 ± 300 | 3,390 | Measured 69% | On track (+0.21); macro-mismatch note | plan 3,390 |
| 12 | 3,180 ± 310 | 3,390 | Measured 68% | On track (+0.67) | kept 3,390 |

## 3. Confusions
- **Home / Weight card:** tapping the big "Weight" card opens a trend chart, not an add form. The add button is the small "+ Weight".
- **Nutrition ⚙:** the goal starts as "Maintain". I only found Gain in the settings gear, and the gain rate there is a % of body weight.
- **Food log:** "Add entry" appears twice, once as a heading and once as the button. Save changes for an Edit is below the fold.
- **Day totals / Protein card:** if one meal has no macros, the day's macro total vanishes and the whole day drops out of protein. Protein showed "— g / 99 g" even though I had logged 83 g.
- **Recommendation (days 2–7):** it said "on-track check needs 14 days (day 1 so far)" on day 7. It only updates on Sundays and never says so there.
- **Last 14 days list:** dates before I installed the app show as "not logged".
- **"On track":** it shows almost every week, even with a negative rate (−0.17, −0.02) on a gain goal. It really means "the target is inside a wide 95% range", but it reads like praise.
- **Week-5 advice (possible bug, see below):** "eat 620 more than recently" came with a suggested intake below my logged average.
- **Explain the math:** too technical for me (Hall 2008, Forbes, MAD, φ, Kalman), with odd spacing like "3 day s" and "weight s".
- **Silence on intake vs target:** the app never says my logged intake runs 400–700 kcal above target every week.
